categories.name: Order & Delivery
categories.description: Fulfillment delays, package tracking errors, damaged shipments, missing items, and address issues.

subcategories.name: Delayed Delivery
subcategories.description: Order missed promised delivery date or has been stuck in carrier transit.

subcategories.name: Lost Package in Transit
subcategories.description: Carrier marked package delivered but customer did not receive it, or tracking stopped updating.

subcategories.name: Wrong Item Delivered
subcategories.description: Package arrived containing an incorrect item, wrong size, or wrong color variant.

subcategories.name: Item Damaged in Transit
subcategories.description: Product package arrived broken, crushed, or physically torn during transit.

subcategories.name: Delivery Address Issue
subcategories.description: Package dispatched to wrong address or courier reported invalid shipping address.

categories.name: Billing & Payments
categories.description: Invoice discrepancies, duplicate charges, payment gateway failures, and VelvoPay disputes.

subcategories.name: Duplicate Payment Deducted
subcategories.description: Customer credit card or VelvoPay wallet charged multiple times for a single checkout.

subcategories.name: Incorrect Charge on Checkout
subcategories.description: Billed price differs from item display price or checkout subtotal.

subcategories.name: Refund Not Processed / Delayed
subcategories.description: Approved refund amount failed to post to bank or VelvoPay account.

subcategories.name: Failed Payment Transaction
subcategories.description: Payment failed at gateway but funds were debited from customer account.

subcategories.name: Gift Card / Voucher Application Error
subcategories.description: VelvoCart gift card code rejected or balance not applied to order total.

categories.name: Returns & Refunds
categories.description: Return authorization disputes, return label issues, item rejection at Return Hub, and refund adjustments.

subcategories.name: Return Request Denied
subcategories.description: System or automated portal declined return request for an eligible product.

subcategories.name: Return Refund Processing Delay
subcategories.description: Item received at Return Hub but refund status remains pending beyond SLA.

subcategories.name: Return Shipping Fee Dispute
subcategories.description: Customer charged return shipping fee for a seller fault or defective item.

subcategories.name: Item Rejected at Return Hub
subcategories.description: Drop-off facility refused return item due to packaging or tag inspection dispute.

categories.name: Product Quality & Authenticity
categories.description: Defective electronics, counterfeit goods, safety hazards, missing parts, and inaccurate descriptions.

subcategories.name: Defective or Malfunctioning Product
subcategories.description: Product does not power on, has hardware failure, or stops working shortly after arrival.

subcategories.name: Counterfeit / Fake Item Delivered
subcategories.description: Received item is knockoff, unbranded copy, or fake replica of brand name product.

subcategories.name: Item Not as Described
subcategories.description: Product specifications, size, color, or features differ significantly from product listing.

subcategories.name: Missing Accessories or Components
subcategories.description: Product arrived missing key power cords, user manuals, assembly hardware, or accessories.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.description: Account login problems, password reset, account lockouts, VelvoCart Prime subscription cancellation.

subcategories.name: Unable to Login / Password Reset Error
subcategories.description: Customer locked out of account or authentication codes fail to deliver.

subcategories.name: Account Suspended or Restricted
subcategories.description: Account temporarily or permanently blocked by automated risk system.

subcategories.name: Profile / Address Update Failure
subcategories.description: Saved credit cards, shipping address, or phone number fail to update.

subcategories.name: VelvoCart Prime Renewal / Cancellation Issue
subcategories.description: Prime membership charged after cancellation or auto-renew failed to apply discount.

categories.name: Account Security & Fraud
categories.description: Unauthorized orders, stolen credentials, stolen payment methods, account takeovers, and scam reports.

subcategories.name: Unauthorized Order / Credit Card Fraud
subcategories.description: Order placed on customer account without their knowledge or authorization.

subcategories.name: Account Takeover Suspected
subcategories.description: Credentials compromised, email changed, or unauthorized password change detected.

subcategories.name: Phishing / Scam Seller Report
subcategories.description: Customer received suspicious SMS/email pretending to be VelvoCart asking for credentials.

subcategories.name: Data Privacy / Security Incident Concern
subcategories.description: Report of potential customer data leak or exposed personal information.

categories.name: Marketplace & Seller Operations
categories.description: Third-party seller disputes, unresponsive merchants, shipping delays from marketplace vendors.

subcategories.name: 3rd-Party Seller Non-Response
subcategories.description: Marketplace seller failed to reply to buyer inquiry or return request within 48 hours.

subcategories.name: Fraudulent Seller Listing
subcategories.description: Third-party seller listing suspected of ghost stock or deceptive marketing.

subcategories.name: Seller Policy Violation
subcategories.description: Seller included unauthorized external payment links or requested offline money transfer.

categories.name: Customer Service Experience
categories.description: Support agent misconduct, excessive hold times, bot loop frustration, and unfulfilled agent promises.

subcategories.name: Unprofessional Agent Conduct
subcategories.description: Customer reports rude, dismissive, or abusive behavior by support staff or chat agent.

subcategories.name: Extended Support Hold Time
subcategories.description: Waited over 45 minutes on phone or live chat queue without reaching representative.

subcategories.name: Repeated Unresolved Issue
subcategories.description: Issue remains unresolved after 3 or more support interactions.

categories.name: Promotions & Pricing
categories.description: Promo codes failing to apply, misleading price discounts, flash sale pricing glitches.

subcategories.name: Promo Code / Discount Rejected
subcategories.description: Valid promotional coupon code failed to apply discount during checkout.

subcategories.name: Checkout Price Higher than Advertised
subcategories.description: Final checkout total exceeded product page advertised promotional price.

subcategories.name: Misleading Deal / Flash Sale Dispute
subcategories.description: Promotional terms were deceptive or stock ran out instantaneously.

categories.name: Regulatory & Legal Compliance
categories.description: Consumer rights violations, data privacy access/deletion (CCPA/GDPR), legal notices, regulator filings.

subcategories.name: Data Privacy Law Violation
subcategories.description: Customer personal data shared or processed without consent under statutory privacy laws.

subcategories.name: Statutory Consumer Rights Infringement
subcategories.description: Allegation that VelvoCart terms breach statutory warranty or consumer protection acts.

subcategories.name: Formal Legal Notice / Attorney Involvement
subcategories.description: Complaint submitted by attorney or referencing FTC, Attorney General, or BBB lawsuit.
